role: A/B evidence for the transaction save projection round
environment: BENCH_SAMPLES=9, 3 alternating rounds (rounds 1 and 3 run the baseline first, round 2 the candidate first), each side in its own process. Per row: `rawElapsedMs`/`rawCpuMs` are that round's 9 samples in order, `medianElapsedMs`/`medianCpuMs` their median, `syscalls` the per-flush medians of the durability and JSON counters.
derivation: Every table in docs/performance/domain-transaction-save-projection.md is computed from this file: per side and round take medianElapsedMs/medianCpuMs, then per round the ratio candidate/baseline, then take the median of the three round ratios. The `saveCount` column is median(parseCalls, baseline) - median(parseCalls, candidate).
baseline: git archive 2ff472a (the commit this round starts from), run from a /tmp copy sharing this repository's node_modules; the benchmark script of this round (with the JSON counters) is copied into both sides
candidate: the working tree of this round
jsonCounters: JSON.parse/JSON.stringify are wrapped for the measured flush only; parseChars/stringifyChars sum the character count of each call's input/output
